subject: FYQ3 billing milestone — invoice sequencing & PO arrival plan
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FYQ3 billing milestone — invoice sequencing & PO arrival plan

Team,

We need a short, auditable plan for Evergreen Health (RDW-2089) so finance can map bookings to the correct recognition periods. Key asks and constraints below — please reply with confirmations by EOD Monday 9/6: 

- PO arrival window: we need an expected PO issue date or a commitment window (exact day preferred). Vanessa, can you confirm if Evergreen indicated a target PO date during procurement calls?
- Invoice sequencing: Marissa, propose whether we should send an interim invoice (50%) on delivery or hold a single invoice upon PO receipt to match AP timing. Include the impact on recognition month if PO comes in after 9/15.
- Sales confirmation: Ben, confirm whether we should ship/enable on engineering sign-off or wait for PO. If we ship, will client accept an invoice referencing the PO number to come?
- Finance gating: Rishi, note any revenue recognition constraints (cutoff dates or required documentation) that would force booking into next quarter.

Attached: PO_timing_workbook.xlsx — use the yellow column to enter expected PO date and the red column to call out blockers. I’ll consolidate and send to the customer with the Redwood PO template if we need to nudge AP directly.

Goal: Decide by 9/6 so CS can coordinate with Evergreen and Finance can plan September close. Short replies preferred (one-line confirmations are fine).

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Finance Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PO_timing_workbook.xlsx (Excel)]
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FYQ3 billing milestone — invoice sequencing & PO arrival plan

Laura — quick update from CS side. Procurement at Evergreen said their internal PO approval is expected the week of 9/13, with AP scheduling payment terms (Net 30) starting from invoice date. I’ve asked Maya Patel in procurement to confirm a specific PO issuance date — I will push for 9/10 but they flagged a possible committee review on 9/14 which could slip.

Notes:
- AP contact: accounts-payable@evergreenhealth.org (I have the contact but not an explicit date yet).
- CS recommendation: we can enable the service on 9/8 on a limited basis (soft launch) if Sales is comfortable, but we should clarify invoicing approach before full enablement.

I’ve attached a one-pager with their procurement timeline.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: EH_procurement_timeline.pdf (PDF)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 06 Sep 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FYQ3 billing milestone — invoice sequencing & PO arrival plan

Quick draft for invoice sequencing options (impact on recognition):

Option A — Invoice on delivery with PO number to follow:
- Invoice date: 9/09 (assuming soft launch 9/08)
- If PO arrives before 9/15, revenue recognized in September. If PO arrives after 9/15, we may need to treat as deferred until October close depending on revenue ops cutoff.

Option B — Wait for PO, single invoice on PO issuance:
- Invoice date: PO issuance date (expected week of 9/13)
- Ensures AP has PO on file; may move recognition to October if PO slips past 9/30 depending on documentation.

My recommended path is Option A with a clear credit memo process if the PO number differs — keeps recognition in September if AP accepts retrospective PO matching. I’ve attached an Invoice_Draft_EH_Sept2026.xlsx with suggested line items and payment terms.

Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Invoice_Draft_EH_Sept2026.xlsx (Excel)]

To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@evergreenhealth.org>
Cc: accounts-payable@evergreenhealth.org, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood — PO timing & invoice sequencing (request for confirmation)

Maya — following up on procurement timing so we can finalize Redwood’s invoice sequencing and revenue mapping for September close. Internal summary below (short):

- Procurement indicated a likely PO issuance week of 9/13; Evergreen may have a committee review on 9/14 that could push to 9/21.
- Our recommended approach is to enable service on 9/08 and issue an interim invoice 9/09 (Option A) — this preserves September recognition if AP can accept retrospective PO matching. If you prefer Redwood to wait to invoice until PO issuance, we can do Option B but recognize it may shift recognition into October if the PO slips beyond month-end.

Attached is our Redwood_PO_Template_v2.pdf and a draft invoice for visibility. Please confirm which approach Evergreen prefers and, if possible, the target PO issue date. If you send the PO to accounts-payable@evergreenhealth.org, please copy invoices@redwood.com so accounting can match quickly.

If easier, happy to jump on a 15-minute call tomorrow to align.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Finance Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_PO_Template_v2.pdf (PDF)]
